name: Souma Chowdhury
school: University at Buffalo, State University of New York
title: Associate Professor; Director, Adaptive Design Algorithms, Models and Systems Laboratory
department: Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering; adjunct Computer Science and Engineering
fitReason: Direct physical-AI overlap through learned terrain costs for real off-road navigation, alongside a broader swarm and autonomous-system design program.

physicalEvidence.summary: RSS 2026 MAT runs a U-Net learned traversability map, MPPI planning and PID execution on a physical Losi 1/5-scale Racer with Livox MID-360, Jetson Nano and Arduino. Real outdoor trials cross manmade and snow ditches and navigate curbs, rocks and trees. Training begins in BeamNG and is fine-tuned on real data; the long-range maps are simulation. This is a joint Buffalo project hosted by SAIR, not proof of exclusive ADAMS ownership or guaranteed visitor access to its hardware.

name: Yue (Sophie) Wang
title: Professor; Warren H. Owen–Duke Energy Professor of Engineering; Associate Dean for Research, CECAS
fitReason: Strong safe-learning control fit with actual vision-guided RL execution on a collaborative manipulator and generative-model runtime analysis.

physicalEvidence.summary: The May 2026 author-uploaded preprint reports a physical UR5 and ZED2 RGBD camera running PPO/SAC visuomotor control at 10 Hz under a slower asynchronous safety verifier, with safe-stop switching during human-arm intrusions. Policies train in Isaac Lab; the later reported UR5 tests are hardware. The attention GAN synthesizes bounded obstacle variants for verification. Safety is conditional on bounded-motion, visibility and model assumptions; this is not a universal safety guarantee. The manuscript is a preprint, not independently verified peer-reviewed publication.
